name: sherwood-protocol
description: Sherwood Protocol ($ARROW) — a Solana token that harvests pump.fun creator fees, auto-compounds a share into liquidity, and airdrops the rest to holders every 15 minutes.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared -w packages/fee-harvester -w packages/autolp -w packages/snapshot-bot -w packages/token-launch
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck --if-present -w packages/shared -w packages/fee-harvester -w packages/autolp -w packages/snapshot-bot -w packages/token-launch && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/website-v2
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test --if-present -w packages/fee-harvester -w packages/snapshot-bot
